jobs.description:
As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.

• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.

• Track and trace Air Import files as required. This can be either internally via exp.o or externally via airline websites or by telephone to
airline offices.

• Use Tree View on daily basis.

• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for Import shipments.

• Ensure documents are timely sent to customer or broker for customs purposes.

• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.

• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards.

• Contribute to maintain strong relationships with vendors (airlines, trucking companies, and others).

• Meet compliance at all times to regulations. 

• Understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency.

• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed and updated in the DLSOP.

• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)

• Meets company standards of 52 hours training per year per employee.

• Promote compliance in diligently following all company policies and regulations and performing the task at hand with outstanding
integrity and pride.

The Air Import Agent we're looking for:

• 2- 3 years of experience withing air freight (import specifically)

• Proactive attitude and well-developed organizational skills.

• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.

• Very good knowledge of English AND Dutch

• IATA certification is a plus.

• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

jobs.description:
As a Travel agent you are in charge of organising all the travels of the employees of the company

Client Details

International company 

Description

 

• Book flight reservations
• Book rail travel
• Manage hotel reservations using the internal booking system
• Work collaboratively with other team members to ensure optimal service
• Respond promptly to urgent requests and handle unexpected situations efficiently
 

• You already have an experience as a travel agent and you must have an experience already with the Amadeus platform otherwise your application won't be taken into account
• English is the most important language
• You ideally have a bachelor in Tourism
• Strong customer service orientation, with the ability to work independently and accurately
• Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
• Flexible, efficient, and a strong team player

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

Responsibilities

• Define and document clear requirements and standards for traffic initiatives within the program.
• Identify tasks, dependencies, and risks while reporting progress and bottlenecks to key stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain quality management plans to ensure project results meet required standards.
• Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure the success of various projects.
• Document technical and functional information in a structured manner to facilitate knowledge transfer.
• Contribute to the long-term vision of the ecosystem by evaluating new technologies and capacity needs.
• Collaborate with data protection experts to provide necessary input for impact assessments and risk analyses.

Requirements

• 5+ years hands-on experience in Business Analysis or guiding ICT projects.
• Proven experience working within complex IT environments for public sector or governmental organizations.
• Expertise in Process Mapping, Requirements Management, and Risk & Quality Management.
• Proficiency with MS Visio, PowerBI, JIRA, and Confluence.
• Proactive, result-oriented, and capable of structuring complex information with a critical eye.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to align diverse stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with passive knowledge of the other language.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with ANPR systems, camera technology, or traffic enforcement processes.
• Knowledge of DPIA processes and privacy legislation regarding data processing.
• Good knowledge of English for consulting technical documentation.

SAS Global (Scientific Allied Solutions) is an independent partner in animal health, specialising in veterinary diagnostics, autogenous vaccines and contract research. With various subsidiaries and our head office in Belgium, and an international presence across Europe, Asia, Jordan and Brazil, we support vets, farmers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative solutions for healthier animals and more efficient production.
 

To support the continued growth of our three Brazilian subsidiaries, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager.
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation. 

• You foster collaboration and implement group-wide strategies and procedures. 

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives. 

• You contribute to the long-term strategy for Brazil. 

• You build lasting relationships with customers, partners and government bodies. 
 

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least five years’ management experience in an international environment. 

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

For our client specialized in steel, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator!

Job Description:

• 
Set up machines according to the given instructions. 

• 
Monitor the entire process until the finished product. 

• 
Perform physical work where necessary. 

Who are you?

• 
You speak Dutch or English

• 
You have experience as an operator in the metal industry

• 
A stable CV with relevant experiences. 

• 
Willingness to work in day shifts (07:00 - 15:45 or 06:00 - 14:45).

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

As Office Manager, you will be at the heart of the Brussels office, ensuring that everything runs smoothly. You will combine service excellence and operational responsibility whilst working closely with local and international teams to support the day-to-day running of the office and contribute to wider firm initiatives. 

Your Responsibilities
  
• Manage facilities and office services, ensuring the workplace is well equipped, maintained and ready to support colleagues' daily work.  
• Shape the workplace and employee experience to support team growth by identifying practical opportunities to make the Brussels office more welcoming, efficient and well organised.  
• Lead and develop the reception team, creating a high-quality experience for colleagues, clients and visitors. 
• In collaboration with diverse stakeholders (HR, IT, Marketing, the Social Committee as well as international teams) coordinate and deliver office projects and events including client seminars and team building initiatives  
• Build and manage strong supplier relationships, ensuring quality service and value for money.  
• Contribute to Health & Safety, Security, Risk Management, Business Continuity and GDPR  helping maintain a safe and supportive workplace.  
• Encourage ESG initiatives and contribute to the firm's sustainability objectives in Brussels.  
• Participate in the global Office Management quarterly meetings, sharing best practices and bringing innovative ideas to the Brussels office.  
 
• You have minimum 5 years' experience in Office Management and an interest in how office management is evolving through new systems and technologies.  
• Excellent English, with good knowledge of Dutch and French 
• A proactive and motivating leadership style. 
• Clear and confident communication skills. 
• A collaborative "one team" mindset, enabling you to build strong working relationships. 
• Integrity, professionalism and a strong sense of ownership. 
• A creative and practical approach to problem-solving.

A well-established and growing wealth management and investment advisory firm is looking for a Client Administration Officer to join its Brussels office.

This position is ideal for an experienced administrative professional who enjoys working in a client-focused environment, combining executive support, client administration, and financial follow-up.

 

 

You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
• Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
• Welcoming clients and visitors
• Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
• Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
• Managing and maintaining client files and archives
• Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams
• Maintaining and updating client information in internal databases
Client & Financial Administration

• Supporting the opening of bank accounts in coordination with Compliance
• Following up on investment-related administrative processes
• Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders
• Preparing reports, dashboards, and administrative analyses
• Ensuring accurate and compliant client documentation
• Supporting advisors in the day-to-day management of client relationships

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

• Bachelor in Office Management, Management Assistant, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
• Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
• Strong administrative and organizational skills
• Affinity with numbers and financial environments
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Service-oriented, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• High level of discretion and professionalism
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
• Experience with CRM systems or databases is an asset

The hiring company is a medium-sized organization within the financial services sector, specializing in banking and financial services. It is known for its focus on innovation, sustainability, and delivering impactful solutions for its stakeholders

Jobomschrijving

As an ESG & Impact Officer your responsibilities are:

• Conduct ESG and impact due diligence for high-risk investments
• Assess projects across sectors such as infrastructure, mining, agriculture, forestry, and financial services
• Manage external ESG and environmental & social consultants
• Support portfolio companies in implementing ESG management systems and action plans
• Monitor ESG performance and impact outcomes throughout the investment lifecycle
• Strengthen ESG policies, frameworks, tools, and internal processes
• Contribute to impact reporting, case studies, and stakeholder communications
• Coordinate third-party ESG and impact assessments
• Represent the organization at industry events and ESG-related initiatives

A successful ESG & Impact Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, International Development, Political Science, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline
• Strong experience applying IFC Performance Standards
• Exposure to projects in emerging and developing markets
• Solid knowledge of ESG risk assessment methodologies
• Experience reviewing Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS)
• Understanding of impact measurement frameworks, SDGs, Theory of Change, or similar approaches
• Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; Power BI experience is a plus
• Ability to draft high-quality analytical reports and investment documentation in English

Our client is a well-established and growing international company active in the healthcare sector. They are looking for a customer-oriented and proactive Customer Care Representative to join their dynamic team.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire order and after-sales process. You will play a key role in maintaining customer satisfaction while working closely with internal teams in a collaborative and supportive environment.Your Responsibilities

As a Customer Care Representative, you will:

• Handle incoming customer inquiries regarding orders, deliveries, product returns, and after-sales support.
• Coordinate and manage product returns from A to Z, including collection requests, product verification, credit processing, and warehouse follow-up.
• Support the organization and management of products used during events, workshops, and exhibitions.
• Ensure efficient follow-up of customer requests and maintain strong customer relationships.
• Coordinate after-sales service activities for products requiring repair, including shipment, follow-up, and return to customers.
• Work closely with colleagues across different departments to ensure smooth customer operations.

We are looking for someone who:

• Is fluent in Dutch with a strong knowledge of French. English is considered a plus.
• Enjoys customer interaction and communicates professionally and confidently.
• Has strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Demonstrates a proactive mindset and enjoys working as part of a team.
• Is flexible, hands-on, and willing to support colleagues when needed.
• Has a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (especially Word and Excel).
• Knowledge of Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar) is an asset.
• Holds a valid category B driving license.
